name: folder
description: Find, read, save and edit files in your Folder folders.

interface.shortDescription: Your folder files, in a chat
interface.longDescription:
Use the files in your Folder folders in ChatGPT. Find files by name, read them, and answer from what they say. Save a summary of the chat as a new file, save a file you uploaded, or edit the text of one.

Every change is a new version in the file's history, so any of it can be put back. Make a share link for any file; ChatGPT asks you before a link reaches anyone. Nothing is deleted or moved.

Sign in with Apple or Google and choose which folders ChatGPT can use, and whether it may change them. New to Folder? Start without an account: a folder for 24 hours, kept any time with Apple or Google.
defaultPrompt: Save a short summary of this chat as a file.
Undo the last change to my plan.

positive.description: What does my plan.md say about the launch?
positive.prompt: What does my plan.md say about the launch?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds plan.md if its path is unknown, reads it with read_file, and answers from its actual text (the launch is on Thursday). Names the file.

positive.description: Move the launch in plan.md to Friday
positive.prompt: Move the launch in plan.md to Friday
positive.expected_behavior: Reads plan.md, then uses edit_file to replace only the launch day, Thursday, with Friday. Leaves the rest of the file unchanged and says the earlier version stays in the file's history.

positive.description: Save a short summary of this chat as notes/summary.md in my Sample folder
positive.prompt: Save a short summary of this chat as notes/summary.md in my Sample folder
positive.expected_behavior: Uses create_file to make notes/summary.md in the Sample folder with a short Markdown summary, and gives the returned path. If the file already exists, says so instead of replacing it.

positive.description: Undo the last change to plan.md
positive.prompt: Undo the last change to plan.md
positive.expected_behavior: Uses list_versions to find the version before the latest one, then restore_version with that version, and says what the file is now. Reports honestly when plan.md has only one version.

positive.description: Make a link to plan.md that I can send to Sam, for 7 days
positive.prompt: Make a link to plan.md that I can send to Sam, for 7 days
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_share_link for plan.md with 7 days; its first answer says who will be able to open the file and gives a confirm code. Asks the person, and only after they say yes calls it again with the code and gives the link (link.folder.dev/sample/plan.md).

negative.description: What's the weather in Lisbon tomorrow?
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Lisbon tomorrow?
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call Folder tools; Folder holds the person's files, not forecasts.

negative.description: Write me a haiku about autumn
negative.prompt: Write me a haiku about autumn
negative.expected_behavior: Writes the haiku without calling Folder or saving a file unless asked.

publication.release_notes: Want to sell your files or a folder? ChatGPT gets them ready in one folder with a description, then opens folder.dev, where you choose the price and what buyers see.
